name: Art Nouveau

identity.oneLiner: Art Nouveau: a lithographic line, a halo, and flat inks of gold, olive, madder, and peacock.
identity.summary: Art Nouveau (c.1890–1914) is drawn, not filled. A tapered whiplash, an iris, and a peacock-eye halo sit on warm parchment; architectural iron is a Guimard hood and sinuous stems. Botanical is the poster; architectural is the metro.
identity.authenticityNotes: Curves grow from structure; negative space protects content. No mass-repeated flowers, sticker art, or Deco geometry.

axes.shape: Tapered whiplash, iris, peacock eye, and a hooded iron arch; fields stay simple
axes.edge: Double hairline, like a printed plate: brass rule, then an olive rule
axes.surface: Warm parchment and a reserved ivory panel; dark mode is leaded green with brass
axes.elevation: Almost flat; the line does the work, not a shadow
axes.ornament: Eight original masks: vine, whiplash, iris spray, Guimard arch, iron stems, peacock medallion, eyed rule, corner whip
axes.typeVoice: Cormorant Garamond display, italic for the small line, Source Sans 3 for reading; Bellefair signage in the architectural dialect
axes.motion: Measured organic transitions; no animated wallpaper or excessive drift
axes.density: Expansive ceremonial sections, disciplined forms and data
axes.iconography: Natural line shapes; functional labels remain standard

fonts.license: OFL-1.1 (all fonts bundled in the repo)

bands.description: Elegant type, very fine organic rules, minimum display ornament; compact functional composition.
Recognizable flowing hero arch and one decorative stem; controlled botanical/architectural framing.
Full integrated whiplash, botanical spray or structural ironwork with flowing hero and sectional rhythm.

neverDo: Never repeat dense floral wallpaper across forms or product grids.
Never cover copy, prices or input controls with ornament or place ornaments in the pointer hit area.
Never mistake Art Deco gold steps, Groovy pop graphics, or Memphis scatter for organic Art Nouveau.
Never force organic clip paths on input controls; preserve contrast, focus and field labels.
No remote fonts/assets, licensed poster reproductions, runtime packages or ornamental JavaScript.
